articles.title: Crypto traders vs. Wall Street: OKX’s Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange plans to launch tokenized Anthropic shares as its pre-IPO futures trade about 24% above the company’s $83 offering price.

articles.title: Financial firms must act now as quantum computers grow ‘highly advanced,’ IOSCO warns
articles.snippet: No quantum computer can yet break widely used cryptography, but the securities watchdog says banks and blockchains face a yearslong security overhaul that many have barely begun.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal
articles.snippet: Hyperscale Data needs another $74.8 million to complete its Michigan data center project, even after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.

articles.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
articles.snippet: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.
